answer: Make every agent a reviewer: each epoch it must grade three randomly drawn peers and write a short critique, answering their work the way one sonnet answers another. Graders are checked against hidden gold items, so lazy reviews burn stake. A farm of N clones owes 3N real critiques, inference it cannot share, and because overlap is compared pairwise, each new clone raises the odds that a mirror match exposes them all. Honest agents pay a little effort; sybils watch the bill climb like violet dusk.
